### Problem Description
A clear and concise description of the bug encountered.

### Diagnostic Environment
- **Car OBD Version**: [e.g. 0.9.0-rc.1]
- **Windows Version**: [e.g. Windows 11 Pro 23H2 (build 22631)]
- **Adapter Model / Hardware Chipset**: [e.g. Genuine PIC18F25K80 USB, OBDLink SX STN1110, Blue clone v1.5 / v2.1]
- **Connection Type**: [USB Serial / Bluetooth Virtual COM Port]
- **Vehicle Information**:
  - Make: [e.g. Toyota]
  - Model: [e.g. Camry]
  - Year: [e.g. 2018]
  - Protocol (if known): [e.g. ISO 15765-4 CAN (11-bit, 500k)]

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Connect adapter to vehicle and computer.
2. Launch Car OBD and select COM port `...`.
3. Click 'Connect' / 'Scan' / 'Live Data'.
4. See error.

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what should happen.

### Relevant Traffic Logs
If possible, export the session traffic log from **Settings -> Export Traffic Log** and attach or paste the relevant snippet here.

> [!WARNING]
> **Privacy Reminder**: Car OBD automatically masks Vehicle Identification Numbers (`***VIN-REDACTED***`) in traffic logs. Please double check that you do not post any unredacted VIN, personal license plate, or identifying information.

### Screenshots or Error Messages
If applicable, add screenshots or paste exact error text to help explain your problem.
